The head is visible in profile, showing a large dark eye and distinct scale patterns. The body loops around itself, creating layers of texture.

The connection between the head and the first coil of the body feels slightly disjointed. The neck seems to emerge from behind the jawline in a way that is anatomically plausible but visually slightly confused in terms of layering.
